facts.value: UHD 4K at 30 fps or 1080p at 60 fps

facts.note: The spec page writes Field of View (FOV): 90.

facts.value: Wired, USB-C to USB-C cable, 1.5 m
a USB-C port supporting the USB 3.0 standard
Basic webcam support using the USB Video Class (UVC) standard
Logi Options+ / G HUB; Right Sight only with Logi Tune

setup.en: Plug it into a USB-C port that supports USB 3.0. It works as a basic UVC webcam; Logitech's software (Logi Options+, G HUB) adds its settings.
setup.zh: 接到支援 USB 3.0 的 USB-C 埠。它以 UVC 標準當一般網路攝影機用，羅技的軟體（Logi Options+、G HUB）再加上它的設定。

setup.en: The page must be on https or localhost and start the camera from a click; on macOS the browser needs camera access in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
setup.zh: 網頁要在 https 或 localhost 上，並且由一次點擊啟動鏡頭。在 macOS 上，瀏覽器要在「系統設定 → 隱私權與安全性」裡有相機權限。

problems.en: Browsers hide camera labels until the page has had camera permission once, so before that the MX Brio cannot be told apart from another camera by name; open() asks first, then looks again.
problems.zh: 頁面拿到一次相機權限之前，瀏覽器不給鏡頭的名稱，所以在那之前無法用名字分辨 MX Brio 和別的鏡頭。open() 會先要權限，再找一次。

use.en: Finds the MX Brio among the cameras by its label and opens it at 1920×1080, 60 fps as ideal values, only when called.
use.zh: 依名稱在鏡頭裡找到 MX Brio，以 1920×1080、60 fps 為理想值打開它，呼叫了才會做。

use.en: The performance video puts this camera under the work.
use.zh: 演出影片把這顆鏡頭放在作品下方。

sources.title: Logitech: MX Brio UHD 4K Webcam (product page)

open-audiovisual handbook: Troubleshooting, the camera or microphone does not start

notes.en: @openav/pose's PoseTracker and HandTracker open the default camera themselves: choosing this camera for them is not possible yet.
notes.zh: @openav/pose 的 PoseTracker 與 HandTracker 會自己打開預設的鏡頭，目前還不能替它們指定這顆。

tbd.en: The label pattern was written from the model name, not read from a unit: which label Chrome shows for it is not checked.
tbd.zh: 標籤比對式是照型號寫的，不是從實機讀來的。Chrome 把它叫做什麼，還沒有確認。

tbd.en: Whether a browser gets 60 fps at 1920×1080 from it is not checked. The constraints are ideal values, so it opens at what it can.
tbd.zh: 瀏覽器能不能從它拿到 1920×1080、60 fps，還沒有確認。限制條件是理想值，所以它會以做得到的設定打開。
